title: question pages continue back no sliders
rule: Question pages: Continue (not “Submit” jargon); Back link; don’t use range sliders.
pass_when: Question page primary is Continue (not Submit); a Back link is present; no range slider for the answer.
fail_when: Submit jargon on a question page; no Back; or a range slider as the answer control.
overview: Question pages use Continue, a Back link, and no range sliders for answers.
apply_when: Building GOV.UK-style question pages with a primary advance action.
not_when: Not for settings screens that truly submit, or non-question content pages.
agent_hint: Label the primary Continue, include Back, and avoid range sliders for answers.
description: On question pages the primary action is Continue, not Submit jargon; include a Back link; and do not use a range slider as the answer control. Continue names the next step without sounding like a final commit, and Back keeps recovery obvious. Range sliders are a poor fit for precise answers on question pages. Fail for Submit wording on a question page, a missing Back link, or a range slider collecting the answer. Use this on GOV.UK-style question pages.
do_not_claim: Fluent multistep “Next not Continue” as a winner — dual-cite by surface (question page vs multistep settings). Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.copy.verbs_for_actions`.
